paras: Ornithuroscincus sabini is a species of skink. It is endemic to Milne Bay Province, eastern Papua New Guinea. It is terrestrial to semi-arboreal and has been recorded at elevations of 1,200–2,740 m (3,940–8,990 ft) above sea level.
Ornithuroscincus sabini measure 29–69 mm (1.1–2.7 in) in snout–vent length. The limbs are short.
